changes.comment: adaptMcpTools takes an optional schemaKeywords table (get one with AiAssist.clientToolSchemaKeywords) and skips a tool whose schema the target wire cannot carry, defaulting to the conservative JsonSchema.unverifiedWireSchemaKeywords: a tool with an untyped {} parameter (pydantic Any) stays skipped unless the table passes it (Anthropic tools), so it cannot fail every request. Tools using a numeric enum or a scalar const are now adapted, and an out-of-set call is refused before it reaches the server. The skip warning now reads 'inputSchema cannot be adapted: <reason>'.
